study.question: Can activity pair statistics on fields with zero or one distinct target-matching timestamp provide useful context through separate classifier columns, beyond aggregate mass and duplicated incumbent readout capacity?
study.hypothesis: Observed limitation: the incumbent gates its last24 activity/gap features on more than one distinct target-matching timestamp, although the statistics summarize all valid field activity. In r0036, opening this support exposed552/1024 field positions in first512 validation examples (444 zero-match,108 one-match),508 with nonzero pair mass, but AUC fell from0.6209487955 to0.6205685610(pairs) or0.6206660881(mass); Logloss slightly improved from0.1957836803 to0.1957701923/0.1957617635. The merged implementation forces the same first-layer coefficient to read common and newly supported values. Hypothesis: separately read sparse-population context can add useful conditional signal without this constraint. This is a proposed explanation, not established negative transfer. Exact sparse-regime scored outcomes are unavailable. A first512 activity count is not a population prevalence estimate. Earlier r0017 fallback support improved only0.00005595 AUC; r0024 provenance variants, r0034 composition changes and r0035 cadence changes failed to surpass their respective incumbent. These trajectories argue for controls and allow another null outcome.

nearest_work.difference: Exact local parent preserved as prefix. New24 columns independently read either added-population context or duplicated common context. Existing original and unweighted pair coordinates remain unchanged.

Separate support-gated deterministic field/action summaries are the local intervention, not a faithful full DIN reproduction or a verified novel architecture.

inherited_components: All hash-verified incumbent Model constructors, helpers, loss/optimizer defaults, embeddings, normalized attention and deterministic statistics.
r0036 eligible=(activity_groups>1), added=eligible-common partition, positive target/history IDs, causal supplied prefix, exact timestamp grouping and tie distributions.
Symmetric factorized activity action-pair matrix: per-field mean relative-gap weight times symmetrized ordered adjacency; twelve offdiagonal coordinates per field at fixed0.5 scale.

Independent first-layer input weights and deterministic support gating are standard components; no priority claim. Registry searches for sharing, multi-behavior negative transfer and scoped support memory returned no matches; this is not evidence of absence from literature.
study.proposed_difference: Preserve the complete incumbent features f and append z: added_pairs=z=A*x, added_mass=A*sum(x)/12 per field, common_pairs=z=C*x (exact incumbent last24 duplicate), common_mass=C*sum(x)/12 per field. Here x is the eligible factorized symmetric activity pair vector, C the original common mask and A=eligible-C. Every arm appends24 zero-initialized classifier columns with no additional RNG draws, retaining the original C*x block. Thus there are separate learned coefficients for the added regime; all inherited parameters train normally. The factorial controls appended support location and pair allocation. Equal allocated count and initial logits do not equate effective rank. Novelty remains unverified; this is a local mechanism contrast using standard gating and independent readouts.
predictions: All variants have17150755 expected total parameters (3072 above parent17147683),72067 dense parameters, identical state tensors at initialization and same starting logits. Parameter counts require host confirmation.

Parent feature prefix remains exact; added and common supports are disjoint and partition eligible. Added context is exactly zero for missing targets, empty histories or fewer than2 valid activity timestamp groups. Timestamp ties remain distributions and no LxL arrays are introduced.

If the proposed useful sparse context exists, added_pairs should beat both unextended incumbent and common_pairs on validation AUC, and improve on the historical merged variant; the last contrast is capacity-confounded.

Pair-allocation evidence requires added_pairs to beat added_mass and a positive added-vs-common factorial interaction, repeated on paired seeds. If only added_mass improves, interpret aggregate mass/support instead.

First512 frozen-checkpoint diagnostics should show nonzero added exposure, identity errors near float tolerance, finite logits and use of the extra block. Use and changed weights alone will not establish benefit.
falsifiers: No added eligible coordinates, incorrect support partition, changed parent features, nonfinite outputs or material mass-identity errors invalidate execution; preserve failed costs and receipts.
If added_pairs fails to improve AUC over incumbent/common_pairs, this implementation does not support useful independent sparse pair context, even if its block is used or Logloss improves.
If added_mass matches or outperforms added_pairs or interaction is nonpositive across paired repeats, action-pair allocation is not supported.
If duplicate-common controls explain any improvement, attribute no sparse-population gain. A one-seed improvement smaller than seed variation is preliminary and can reflect selection noise.
If runtime or hard budget disallows reserved controls/repetition, stop rather than report mechanism success; no holdout is available.
alternative_explanations: Added activity features carry no residual predictive signal after the inherited stack; the support gate may be useful regularization rather than a limitation.
The r0036 AUC declines and small Logloss gains may reflect ranking/calibration tradeoffs, seed variation or selection over many prior trials, not coefficient conflict.
Extra columns change effective function class and Adam optimization; duplicate common controls only partially account for these effects.
Aggregate switching/gap mass or simple support presence may explain a gain without meaningful action-pair identity.
Sparse target matches differ from rare users and short histories; existing category-match and frequency slices are imperfect proxies and cannot certify the exact gate effect.
Grouping uses coarse category/brand and timestamp distributions, not items, causal action paths or conversion intent. Publisher static-snapshot dates remain undocumented.
